backup.production_rule: get_missed_cleanings counted a cleaning session as covering a checkout when its checkout_date matched OR its cleaned_at UTC date fell on the checkout day or the day after. The second branch fired for a report that names ANOTHER checkout: Honey filed her late reports for 14 and 17 Oct on 21 Oct 22:36 Manila, which hid the real 21 Oct checkout (no report) from get_missed_cleanings, from the cleaner's Pay screen 'No report yet', from the 'Cleaning report missing' follow-up tasks, and made staff_pay_admin_create_v2 / staff_pay_request_create_v2 refuse it as advance_not_owed. The window now applies ONLY to a session with no checkout_date and uses the Manila date ((cleaned_at at time zone 'Asia/Manila')::date), the rule s_advance_session_v1 already uses. Replaces ONLY public.get_missed_cleanings(uuid,integer) (s91 body md5 ce6a29c3a3ad63ea4eef3e4eba410885 guarded, 55000 on mismatch); signature, plpgsql, stable, SECURITY INVOKER, search_path '', the D-290 same-guest clause and the order are unchanged. Grants restated (ML-21): revoke from public, anon; execute to authenticated and service_role. Callers: missed-cleaning-alert (edge, service_role), get_admin_overview_v1 (14 days), staff_pay_admin_create_v2, staff_pay_request_create_v2, staff_pay_candidates_v1 (30 days). Expected effect: every checkout hidden ONLY by the old date-window fallback becomes visible again (21 Oct, Ysabel, is the known one). The data step supabase/sql/2026-10-27-s99e-honey-2700.sql (Lloyd's block, AFTER this migration) records Honey's PHP 2,700 BPI payment 2026-10-27 (21, 22, 24, 25 Oct at 650 + KitKat claim corrected 50 to 100).
backup.notes: Phase expand: one function body replaced, no table, column or data touched. Old callers keep working (same signature and columns). Deploy order: SQL, then the data step. No edge or app deploy is needed: missed-cleaning-alert, the Pay screen and the pay functions read the function. First daily missed-cleaning-alert run after the apply (00:00 UTC = 08:00 Manila): every row with 4+ days overdue becomes a Follow-ups task 'Cleaning report missing' (21 Oct = 7 days overdue at the 28 Oct run, 22 Oct = 6), a checkout exactly 3 days overdue gets the one OPS reminder (25 Oct at the 28 Oct run), 0-1 days an alert. The tasks close themselves when the report is filed; paying a date ahead does not file a report, so the tasks for 21, 22 and 25 Oct stay until Honey files them. The live ACL of get_missed_cleanings could not be read offline (hand-applied before the migration history): read proacl once before the apply; the restated grants match the stay_chains notes and its pgTAP (service_role execute).
